// serialize.ts
export function serialize(user) { return JSON.stringify({ id: user.id, name: user.name }); }
input.test: test('public wire payload', () => expect(serialize({ id: 7, name: 'Ada' })).toMatchInlineSnapshot('"{\"id\":7,\"name\":\"Ada\"}"'));
input.context: No hooks, helpers, mocks, imports or additional assertions are omitted.
input.contract: Published wire payload requires exactly id and name in this order. This snapshot was reviewed against that external specification.

rationale: Snapshots are not inherently tautological when they encode an independent external contract.
